%1$s%2$s%3$s%4$sis a board game themed b: %1$s%2$s%3$s%4$sis a board game themed board. The board is split up into four quadrants, each themed after one of the four card suits.
%1$sThis board features a karma system. Each player has both a Positive Karma (good karma) and Negative Karma (bad karma) score. Karma can be thought of as an additional currency with each of them capping at 10.
%1$sPositive Karma (\uE005) can be acqui: %1$sPositive Karma () can be acquired by performing good deed actions that involve interacting with NPCs in a way that's favorable to them (buying a merchant's items, paying dues to the Diamond Queen, beating a challenge and enhancing or duplicating an item) as well as triggering a green space.
%1$sNegative Karma (\uE006) can be acqui: %1$sNegative Karma () can be acquired by performing actions that involve interacting with NPCs or other players in a way that's unfavorable to them (skipping a merchant's shop, not paying dues to the Diamond Queen when entering the Diamond quadrant, passing a challenge without attempting it, using an item against another player, pickingpocketing and placing a trap) as well as triggering duels, battle minigames and chance time.
%1$sThis board has two %2$s active at al: %1$sThis board has two %2$s active at all times. There will always be one Star Seller in a red quadrant (Hearts or Diamonds) and one in a black quadrant (Clubs or Spades).
%1$sThe Star Seller in the red quadrant: %1$sThe Star Seller in the red quadrant will sell a Star at a base cost of 30 Coins and offers options that discount the Coin cost by having the player spend their Positive Karma ().
%1$sThe Star Seller in the black quadran: %1$sThe Star Seller in the black quadrant will sell a Star at a base cost of 30 Coins and offers options that discount the Coin cost by having the player spend their Negative Karma ().
%1$sAfter buying a Star, the Star Seller: %1$sAfter buying a Star, the Star Seller that you bought from will move to the quadrant of the other suit of the same color.
%1$sSacrifice your Positive Karma (\uE00: %1$sSacrifice your Positive Karma () here and get awarded with random items. The more karma sacrificed, the better the chances of getting more and better items!
%1$sSacrifice your Negative Karma (\uE00: %1$sSacrifice your Negative Karma () here. You can visit any spirit to acquire an item of your choosing at the expense of your Negative Karma (). Limit of 1 item per visit.
%1$sVisit %2$s to enhance or duplicate a: %1$sVisit %2$s to enhance or duplicate any item. The cost of enhancement is 25%% the base price of the item and duplication is 50%% of the base price but is 75%% for enhanced items. %3$s allows a limit of 1 visit per turn.
%1$sYou must pay 8 %2$s to enter the dia: %1$sYou must pay 8 %2$s to enter the diamonds quadrant. Paying the full amount gives you 1 Positive Karma (). Failure to pay will result in you losing the rest of your turn but gives you 1 Negative Karma (). %3$s and %4$s allow you to pass the guards without paying and gives you 1 Negative Karma ().
%1$sYou will have 15 seconds to find the: %1$sYou will have 15 seconds to find the copper ingot in the stash of jewels. If you collect the copper in time, you will be rewarded with 15 Coins.
%1$sHelp the %2$s take care of the haunt: %1$sHelp the %2$s take care of the haunted graveyard. You will receive an axe and must kill 4 skeletons that pop out of their graves while avoiding getting shot. If you can kill all the skeletons without getting shot thrice, the %3$s will award you with 10 Coins.
